_source: CORE Math Pacing Guide 6th Grade - Zearn, uploaded by Loren 8/28/26, transcribed by week from the actual per-week lesson lists (not just header rows). Mission 1's Mid-Mission Assessment (week 3) is labeled '(2 days)' in the guide but only Day 1 content ever appears anywhere in the document - no Day 2 exists to transcribe, so it's recorded without a day tag. Week 26's body text labels lessons 17-18 as 'Topic F', which is inconsistent with the mission's own topic lettering (A, B, B, C, then a jump to F with no D or E) and with the header row, which reads 'Topic D: Relationships Between Quantities' for the same lessons - used the header's 'Topic D' here since 'topic' is carried but never read by the engine. No mission-number mislabeling found (unlike Grade 5's week 28) - mission numbers and lesson numbering are continuous throughout. Week 18 originally carried Mission 4's trailing lesson 17 alongside Mission 4's End-of-Mission Assessment and Mission 5's first two lessons, all in the same guide-week; since the per-week schema holds one mission's lessons per week, lesson 17 was folded into week 17's range (12-17 instead of 12-16) rather than dropped, since week 17 and week 18 fall in the same LP window (LP5) so this doesn't change which LP the lesson counts toward. Same comingled-week pattern recurred at week 35 (Mission 8's trailing lessons 17-18, its End-of-Mission Assessment, and Mission 9's lesson 1 all in one guide-week): Mission 9's lesson 1 was moved forward into week 36 instead, since weeks 35 and 36 are both in LP10's window, so this doesn't change which LP anything counts toward and matches Appendix A's own LP10 wording, which keeps Mission 8's lessons 17-18 in LP10 rather than LP9.
